_note: Casters are the caster and support archetypes (phase 3b, Decision 1): Cinder Moth and Gloam Witch in Act 1.
name: Casters first
text: Goes for the nearest enemy caster or support first; with none standing, picks as usual.

name: Hold your ground
text: Stays where it's placed, fighting whatever is in reach, until an enemy comes within 2 hexes; then it moves out for the rest of the fight.

_note: The bar waits, full (phase 3b, Decision 3). Only a mana signature that heals the lowest ally can wait: Vell's Mend (Decision 4).
name: Wait to heal
text: Holds the healing signature, its bar full, until an ally in its reach is badly hurt.
